articles.headline: Santos eye Neymar return after promotion to Brazil's Serie A
articles.description: Santos secured its return to the top tier of Brazilian soccer next year when it hopes that star striker Neymar will be back at the club which achieved a global following with Pelé.

images.name: Neymar Al Hilal 2024 [1296x729]
images.alt: Neymar looks on after the AFC Champions League Elite match between Al Ain and Al-Hilal at Hazza bin Zayed Stadium on October 21, 2024 in Al Ain, United Arab Emirates.

images.name: Gomez: Neymar needs to move to Inter Miami
images.caption: Herculez Gomez believes a move to Inter Miami will benefit Neymar's international career with Brazil.

articles.headline: Coutinho reveals World Cup 2026 'dream' at unveiling
articles.description: Philippe Coutinho shares his hopes to return to Brazil's national team as he comes back to his boyhood club Vasco da Gama.

images.name: Coutinho reveals World Cup 2026 'dream' at unveiling
images.caption: Philippe Coutinho shares his hopes to return to Brazil's national team as he comes back to his boyhood club Vasco da Gama.

articles.headline: Ex-Liverpool, Brazil midfielder Lucas Leiva retires due to heart condition
articles.description: Gremio and former Liverpool midfielder Lucas Leiva announced his retirement from football on Friday due to a heart condition.

images.name: Lucas Leiva Lazio 2022 [1296x729]
images.alt: Lucas Leiva of SS Lazio greets the fans at the end of the Serie A match between SS Lazio and Hellas Verona FC at Stadio Olimpico on May 21, 2022 in Rome, Italy.
